changes: All upstream runtime files, bundled Country.mmdb/geosite.dat and regression tests retained. Original file checksums and reference locations are recorded in UPSTREAM_FILES.json. Root README, installation defaults and local-source privacy filtering are adapted for this panel. Upstream author funding and issue-cleanup workflow are retained as inactive reference files under .github/upstream; upstream shell tests target this repository main branch. Panel setup checks bundled resources and atomically restores missing geodata when reusing an installation, without replacing existing nonempty databases.
